This targeted reallocation moves 0.02 weight from expansion to path intrusion while preserving the overall base-weight sum. It is supported directly by the supplied results: the same formulation scored 0.9301 versus the current 0.9282, improved Spearman from 0.9404 to 0.9436, pairwise accuracy from 0.8873 to 0.8906, parent-floor Spearman from 0.9369 to 0.9405, and negative-control gap from 0.9320 to 0.9348.

Crucially, false-clear also decreased from 0.0411 to 0.0377, so the aggregate improvement does not trade away the hard safety diagnostic. The cost is a modest false-block increase from 0.0920 to 0.0955 and slightly lower Macro-F1 than the less conservative alternative, but this is the strongest supplied safety-compatible combined-score result. The interaction remains compact and interpretable: corroborated approach/looming motion is boosted only when consistency and quality jointly warrant it, and attenuated otherwise.
